questions.question: In Jesus' story of the vineyard workers, the landowner agreed to pay the first workers a denarius for how long a time of work?
In Jesus' story of the vineyard workers, in what order did the landowner tell his foreman to pay them?
In Jesus' story of the vineyard workers, the workers hired first thing in the morning each received more than a denarius. True or false?
In Jesus' story of the vineyard workers, what did the landowner ask the worker who grumbled about his pay?

answers.text: Are you envious because I am generous
Are you tired because the day was long
Are you angry because the work was hard
